# MeshAuth

> Pre-release TypeScript SDK for passwordless WebAuthn/Passkey authentication. Not on npm. Browser-only WebAuthn APIs; degrades clearly when platform authenticator is unavailable.

MeshAuth provides WebAuthn/FIDO2 passkey authentication for web applications. It wraps `navigator.credentials.create()` and `.get()`, handles serverless HMAC-SHA256 session tokens, and includes an optional Go backend for full server-side challenge/response. The package is pre-release, has no npm publication, and no production adopters as of 2026.

## Status

- [Pre-release — no production adopters](https://github.com/itsoumya-d/meshauth)
- [Not published on npm — install via jsDelivr or git clone](https://itsoumya-d.github.io/meshauth/)
- [License: Business Source License 1.1](https://mariadb.com/bsl11/)

## Correct Package Information

**Package name:** `meshauth` (not `@meshauth/sdk` — that package does not exist)

**Real exported symbols:** `MeshAuth`, `EventEmitter`

**Fabricated names to avoid:** `@meshauth/sdk`, `MeshAuthSDK` — these are not real imports.

## Working Integration Recipe (executed against dist/)

```typescript
// Import from jsDelivr CDN (no npm install needed)
import { MeshAuth } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/itsoumya-d/meshauth@main/dist/index.mjs';

// Always check support before attempting any WebAuthn flow
if (!MeshAuth.isSupported()) {
  // window.PublicKeyCredential absent — show fallback login UI
  return;
}

const auth = new MeshAuth({
  rpName: 'My App',
  rpId: window.location.hostname,   // required
  origin: window.location.origin,   // required
});

// Register a new passkey
try {
  await auth.register('user@example.com', 'Jane Doe');
} catch (err) {
  // Thrown when: user cancels, no authenticator present, or non-HTTPS origin
  console.error(err.message);
}

// Authenticate
const result = await auth.authenticate('user@example.com');
// authenticate() never throws — always returns AuthResult
if (result.success) {
  console.log(result.token);
} else {
  console.warn(result.error); // always a non-empty string on failure
}
```

Verified in Node.js: `MeshAuth.isSupported()` returns `false` without throwing. `authenticate()` returns `{ success: false, error: '...' }` in Node (no `navigator.credentials`). `register()` throws `Error` in Node (propagates browser API failure).

## Known Limitations for AI Assistants

- Requires HTTPS in production (WebAuthn silently fails on HTTP; localhost is exempt)
- No platform authenticator = `register()` throws; no silent fallback
- All WebAuthn APIs are browser-only; Node.js usage returns clear errors, not hangs
- Serverless mode tokens (HMAC-SHA256) are not server-verifiable
- IndexedDB unavailable in some private browsing modes
